texts.name: Kiana
texts.biography: Kiana's unwavering determination has made her a stalwart defender of Refuge against the darkest sorceries. She shields her allies from harm, ensuring that no enchantment can sway their resolve. However, her tyrannical attitude often leads her into trouble.

specialty.name: Resistance
specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Resistance skill percentage.
